sentences.span: S&P buyback demand is running at ~$5bn a day and 90% of corporates are in the open window Monday.
sentences.why: Figures match exactly; corroborated in companion Goldman desk notes 25735/26077, which frame buyback desks against systematic/trend-follower selling, supporting the 'outbidding the machines' framing.

sentences.span: with gubernatorial wins in Texas, Georgia and Ohio, in theory up to around 40% of planned capacity is impacted
sentences.why: Goldman frames the number as a share of planned capacity at risk, not a cancellation; corroborated by GS note 25739 ('moratoriums are not bans or cancellations') and Allianz note 25594 ('Not every delay is a cancellation').

sentences.span: around 45 GW across 350 projects in Texas, Ohio, Pennsylvania and Georgia at risk between 2026-30, including 24 GW in Texas alone
sentences.why: Exact match, authored by Citadel Securities' head of macro strategy per the article byline.

sentences.span: I think we could end up with a temporary moratorium that lasts several months until new rules can be put in place. [...] Texas Governor-elect Gina Hinojosa has explicitly stated that all currently permitted data centers in Texas will be allowed to complete construction [...] she has limited ability to impose a data center moratorium.
sentences.why: The Phillips clause matches Goldman's weekend macro call; the Hinojosa clause matches UBS's 'Just the FAQs' note, consistent with the sentence's own (UBS) attribution.

sentences.span: the generic 30y spread widening only 2.2bps on day while SPX sold off 4.4% (8.2bp expected from regression)
sentences.why: Matches 2.2bp spread widening, 4.4% equity drop, and ~8bp (8.2 rounds to 8) implied move, attributed to Goldman.

sentences.span: but Thursday's selloff hit the spending recipients
sentences.why: Source says the selloff hit the 'spending recipients' (picks-and-shovels sellers: chipmakers/power/networking/cooling), while the 'AI spenders' who issue the bonds (hyperscalers) actually rose. The sentence inverts this, implying the bond-issuing spenders were hit rather than spared, and never names the group that was actually hit.

sentences.span: the consumer staples index now trades ~2x the 24month forward multiple of the semicondutors index / The Nasdaq 100's forward P/E is now 18.4x, the lowest since 2020
sentences.why: Both figures matched verbatim in separate Goldman desk notes.

sentences.span: stocks are now clearly in oversold territory ... We favor NVDA and AVGO, which imply no growth from 2027 ... prefer AMAT & LRCX ... Samsung/SK Hynix now below total book
sentences.why: All named tickers, sector buckets, and the tangible-book framing match this Goldman GIR semiconductors note.

sentences.span: On Oct 30, January Brent tagged $118 as the market braced for a post-midterm Gulf escalation... Brent closed the week just under $98 after its steepest weekly drop since the COVID crash of April 2020 - and ... its biggest in dollar terms on LSEG data going back to 1988.
sentences.why: Every figure and both historical comparisons match the source exactly.

sentences.span: UBS's Dominic Ellis warned on Thursday that "Fundamentals Still Provide A Floor," arguing that the near-700 million barrel drawdown in global inventories won't refill itself just because Congress changed hands.
sentences.why: Name, bank, figure and the Congress-changed-hands causal claim all match verbatim.

sentences.span: At 3.1% y/y they've decelerated from 3.9% 12 months earlier... Perhaps the only softness was in hours worked: production worker hours worked fell 0.2%m/m
sentences.why: MS's own note frames a hot payrolls report alongside decelerating wage growth and softer hours, directly supporting 'wages did not confirm the heat.'

sentences.span: At 3.1% y/y they've decelerated from 3.9% 12 months earlier... production worker hours worked fell 0.2%m/m to begin the quarter.
sentences.why: Exact match on both figures, correctly attributed to Morgan Stanley.

sentences.span: The weak link in Goldman's downgrade is the Fed
sentences.why: Source states the price-target cut's rationale is the Fed outlook, not a reassessment of gold's own investment case, matching the sentence's framing.

sentences.span: Rich Privorotsky argued that "gold has become an inverse oil trade", making long gold "potentially a more defensible de-escalation trade than short oil," while the commodities desk's Adam Gillard noted that Goldman's CTA model is "close to max short" with the "pain trade likely higher."
sentences.why: Both attributions, the inverse-oil-trade framing, the de-escalation comparison, and the max-short/pain-trade-higher claim all match verbatim; CTA model is a faithful expansion to 'trend-follower model.'

sentences.span: Democrats can make holding it back costly, through hearings, legislation tightening chip exports, and conditions written into defence and budget bills
sentences.why: The day's sources support restrictions likely tightening via a political/congressional mechanism, but none use or support an 'intelligence angle' as the driver.
